{{Quote|This is Bors Kenlin in the Rose. We're yours, Antilles.|Bors Kenlin surrendering to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War" />}}
'''Bors Kenlin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Bacta Tanker]] ''[[Xucphra Rose]]''.<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War" />
During the [[Bacta War]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Kenlin was part of a convoy making a delivery of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] and was attacked by the former members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]]. Kenlin willingly went with them to the colony [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Halanit]] despite [[Ysanne Isard]]'s, who was currently ruling the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], threat to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the family members of those who surrendered. According to Kenlin, Isard would be doing him a favor by killing his [[Bors Kenlin's wife|wife]].<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War" />
